profile_text.body:
CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings Inc. is a public company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, trading under the ticker CCC. Its website is calgoncarbon.com, which presents Calgon Carbon's activated carbon business.

The website describes Calgon Carbon as an activated carbon leader in air and water purification. It highlights FILTRASORB, a reagglomerated coal-based activated carbon, citing over 40 years of success in applications such as TOC reduction and contaminant removal from drinking water, wastewater treatment, and purification in process water, food, pharmaceutical, and industrial arenas. FILTRASORB is made in the United States.

The company has 375 legal exposure items in Illinois and no litigation cases are identified. Its CIK is 0001818201.
